title: FM Global Account and Operations Director
text:
**Job Overview**

Flexim Group is seeking an experienced Global Account Operations Manager to provide senior operational leadership for a strategic international account operating across complex sites and manufacturing environments.

Based in Jersey City, you will hold global accountability for operational performance across the account, leading regional and site teams to deliver consistent FM and technical services, safety, compliance and business continuity.

This is a management operations role requiring strong experience, technical credibility and the ability to lead through senior regional and site operations teams. You will set operational standards, challenge performance, manage critical escalations and translate global client priorities into disciplined execution across countries and facilities.

**Duties**

* Lead global operational performance across a complex, multi-country manufacturing account.
* Lead and challenge regional and site Operations Managers, ensuring clear accountability and consistent execution.
* Drive services excellence, with a strong focus on asset reliability, maintenance, utilities and critical infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce global operational standards, while ensuring effective implementation at regional and site level.
* Monitor and challenge operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, CMMS/BMS data, maintenance completion, backlog and asset uptime.
* Lead critical operational escalations.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, service quality and cost performance.
* Lead global account financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control and profitability.
* Partner with senior client stakeholders, translating strategic objectives into operational priorities and measurable results.
* Act as the senior operational authority for the account, providing executive-level governance, reporting and decision-making.

**Experience**

* Substantial operational leadership experience in Integrated Facilities Management, ideally across a multi-country portfolio.
* Strong working knowledge of hard FM and building engineering services
* Demonstrated experience controlling SLAs, KPIs, CMMS workflows, asset registers, maintenance backlogs and technical compliance.
* Proven ownership of account P&L, budgeting, forecasting, subcontractor costs and commercial change control.
* Experience leading dispersed operational teams and managing specialist service providers across different regulatory environments.
* Confident client-facing leadership, supported by operational discipline, sound judgement and a willingness to be present on site.
* Significant leadership experience within Integrated Facilities Management.
* Proven success managing complex global or multi-country client accounts.
* Strong executive stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Strong understanding of operational excellence, governance and performance management.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills.
* A proactive, accountable and client-centric leadership style.

Pay: $135,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jersey City, NJ 07307
